method: Public web screening plus selected public government corporate-license records; no deed census or buyer communication.
source_priority: Official company market/criteria/contact disclosures for claims about offerings
TREC public broker-company records and SEC/IAPD for exact named entities
FTC and government publications for regulatory findings
BBB complaints and responses for allegations and identity cross-checks
Anonymous Reddit accounts as unverified diligence leads only
search_families: Houston/Harris and Dallas/DFW cash/as-is/tax-delinquent home buyers
Local private buyers, wholesale brokerages, franchise and brand networks
iBuyer market availability and current property exclusions
Institutional SFR holdings, acquisitions, development and sourcing
Exact company/domain plus BBB complaints/reviews, Reddit, RealBiz
Exact company/broker-company names in TREC; adviser identity in SEC/IAPD
Official Harris/Dallas County Clerk recorder access and bulk-data paths
limits: No exhaustive title/deed census, litigation search, entity registry clearance or proof of funds
No current ZIP/price/cadence invented from metro language or holdings
Self-reported claims labeled and confidence scope bounded
Historical institutional evidence retained as historical, not current mandate
Targeted RealBiz queries yielded no usable entity-linked review evidence
No meaningful acquisitions/data-procurement route found for several institutional candidates; generic corporate pages labeled accordingly
No private marketplace or MLS access; public company descriptions of those sources only
excluded_or_not_merged: Unrelated Big State Real Estate Inc in Lubbock not mapped to Big State Home Buyers
Separate similarly named TX Cash businesses not merged
Houston House Buyers BBB/domain identity unresolved, candidate held
Expired/other Opendoor entity records not substituted for active Opendoor Brokerage LLC
Foreign similarly named Praedia businesses not used as corroboration
